name: WF-224 — Transaction Readiness → Title/Attorney/Funding/Broker Closing Coordination

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json;const d=input.deal??input;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const transaction_status=String(d.transaction_status??d.status??"").toLowerCase();const closing_date=d.closing_date??d.target_closing_date??null;const seller=d.seller??{};const buyer=d.buyer??{};const coordination=d.coordination??{};const parties={seller_name:String(d.seller_name??seller.name??seller.full_name??"").trim(),buyer_name:String(d.buyer_name??buyer.name??buyer.full_name??"").trim()};const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];const required=["title","attorney","funding","broker"];const assignments=required.map(role=>({role,contact:coordination[role]?.contact??d[role+"_contact"]??null,status:String(coordination[role]?.status??d[role+"_status"]??"pending").toLowerCase()}));const missing=assignments.filter(x=>!x.contact);let state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Closing coordination is not authorized.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){reason="Missing transaction identity.";}else if(!["transaction_ready","ready","closing_ready"].includes(transaction_status)){reason="Transaction is not in a closing-ready state.";}else if(!closing_date){reason="Closing date is missing.";}else if(!parties.seller_name||!parties.buyer_name){reason="Required seller/buyer identity is incomplete.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Unresolved transaction blockers prevent coordination.";}else if(missing.length){state="coordination_incomplete";route="WF-204";reason="One or more required closing coordination roles are missing contact assignment.";}else{state="coordination_ready";route="WF-205";reason="Title, attorney, funding, and broker coordination assignments are ready for milestone monitoring.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-224",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,transaction_status,closing_date,parties,assignments,missing_roles:missing.map(x=>x.role),blockers,state,route,reason,requires_human_review:true}}];
